thread:
Zara (Design): Sketch drop 1: inline hovercard for invoice line items to reveal token breakdown + quick export. Intention: avoid full expand for quick checks. Figma: https://figma.com/file/hovercard :sparkles:
Ethan (PM): Nice. Key asks: keep totals visible, ensure hovercard works on touch (tap-to-open), and make Org vs Project scope obvious in header.
Riya (Frontend): Hover vs tap is always tricky. Suggest hover shows on pointer devices; on touch we show a chevron to open the same card. Keep card content lazy-rendered.
Kai (Eng): Perf: avoid rendering histograms for every hover. Render a lightweight placeholder and fetch detailed payload on first open. Use caching for repeated opens.
Megan (Data): From metrics, users glance at token splits ~15% of the time. We should track hovercard.open and hovercard.export. Payload: invoice_id, line_id, scope.
Zara (Design): Microcopy: header of card: "Token breakdown"; subline: "Estimated tokens • ~USD". Quick actions: Download CSV, Copy line, Open dispute. Thoughts?
Ethan (PM): Add "View full details" CTA that opens the accordion for deeper inspection. Keep export obvious.
Riya (Frontend): Accessibility: hovercards must be focusable. Use role="dialog" with aria-modal="false" and ensure Escape closes. For chevron/tap, aria-expanded on trigger.
a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: ensure focus moves into card when opened via keyboard, use aria-live polite for content that loads asynchronously, provide dismiss button with clear label, and respect prefers-reduced-motion for animations. Color contrast for tokens/text >=4.5:1.
Kai (Eng): Implementation plan: 1) client shows placeholder, 2) fetch /invoice/:id/line/:id/breakdown on first open, 3) cache result, 4) track metrics. We'll feature-flag server-side for rollout.
Megan (Data): Events: hovercard.open, hovercard.fetch.latency, hovercard.export. Also log unit preference (tokens|USD).
Zara (Design): I'll add a touch variant to Figma and include states for loading, error, and empty data.
Ethan (PM): Sync tomorrow 9am PT to align on analytics and rollout. Riya/Kai please bring quick implementation notes.
Riya (Frontend): Will prototype keyboard flow and tap behavior.
Kai (Eng): Will draft API contract and caching TTL.
Zara (Design): Tagging @a11y-bot for checklist on the spec once updated. :white_check_mark:
